stem: Alok draws a straight path that starts at point $M$, ends at point $N$, and does not continue past either point.

parts.text: Which claim correctly names that path?

options.text: A line segment $MN$, because it has two endpoints $M$ and $N$.
A ray that starts at $M$ and continues forever past $N$.
A line through $M$ and $N$ that extends forever in both directions.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The path stops at both M and N, so it is a line segment with two endpoints.

teacher.key_rationale: Two endpoints and no forever side make a line segment. A ray needs one forever side. A line needs forever in both directions.
